[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/30 (Tue) 01:34  
[USER] User asked for an icebreaker to help participants relax at the beginning of a training session.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested the icebreaker activity called "Two Truths and a Lie."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Instructions for "Two Truths and a Lie":  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Each participant comes up with two true statements and one false statement about themselves.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Participants share their three statements with the group without revealing which one is the lie.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. The group guesses which statement is the lie.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. The participant reveals the lie and shares more information about the two true statements.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The activity is effective for sharing personal information in a fun and low-pressure way.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The icebreaker encourages active listening and engagement among participants.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The activity can be adapted to fit different training topics or themes, such as team-building.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Example adaptation: Participants could relate their statements to work experience or teamwork skills.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Overall, "Two Truths and a Lie" helps create a relaxed and engaging atmosphere at the beginning of a training session.  
[USER] User requested more information about the icebreaker.
